params.prompt:
SIZE & IDENTITY OVERRIDE (highest priority, fixes a previous attempt that made the Pyramid far too big and changed the girl's face):
(1) SIZE: the Yogibo Pyramid is a COMPACT soft floor cushion - 66 cm tall upright, 75 x 75 cm base, 2.2 kg. Child KB is 150 cm tall. Copy the child-to-cushion relationship of pose reference #2 and compression reference #7: she sits ON the lower front slope / base of the upright Pyramid with her bottom sinking into the squashed front, so the apex rises only a little above the top of her head and the base is only slightly wider than her body - the cushion must NOT tower over her or spread wide; it is about as tall as her seated torso plus head. The soft bead-filled cushion squashes where she sits: faces bulge outward in smooth rounded curves, edges and apex softly rounded.
(2) IDENTITY: the child must be EXACTLY the girl in face reference #3 / expression sheet #4 - Child KB: 10-12 years old, long STRAIGHT auburn (red-brown) hair with centre parting and NO bangs, freckles across the nose and cheeks, slim pre-teen build; copy her face feature by feature, do not change hair colour/length/style, do not age her; if in doubt make the face look MORE like #3.

COMPRESSION / ROUNDNESS OVERRIDE (highest priority - see reference #7, a real photo of a child sitting on the same Yogibo Pyramid): the Pyramid is a SOFT bead-filled cushion. When someone sits or leans on it, it SQUASHES: its faces bulge OUTWARD in smooth convex rounded curves, the bottom edges spread and round off against the floor, the apex softens into a rounded point, and the whole silhouette reads as a plump, rounded triangular blob - NOT a crisp geometric pyramid with sharp straight edges and flat faces. Copy the soft rounded bulging look of #7 exactly (the same degree of roundness and squash), only the colour, the person and the scene differ. The seams are soft, no hard creases.

Photorealistic e-commerce lifestyle thumbnail, square 1:1, 2048px.

REFERENCES: #1 = the product EMPTY (SHAPE reference - the cushion must look exactly like this, only recoloured). #2 = pose reference with a model (POSE/ANGLE BASE only - ignore its room/background, its colour and its person). #3 = Child KB (girl 10-12) face reference. #4 = Child KB (girl 10-12) expression sheet (8 panels: 1 neutral, 2 soft smile, 3 bright smile, 4 surprised, 5 sad, 6 frown, 7 serious, 8 side-glance smile). #5 = outfit reference KID_B_01. #6 = colour swatch. #7 = COMPRESSION reference: a child sitting on the same Pyramid showing how softly it squashes and bulges (copy its roundness; ignore its colour, person and room).

TASK: Place Child KB with the cherry red Yogibo Pyramid floor cushion of shape reference #1, in the exact pose, cushion orientation and camera angle of #2, in a clean studio.

PRODUCT - Yogibo Pyramid (cherry red): a TRIANGULAR (tetrahedral) SOFT bead-filled FLOOR CUSHION - three sloped triangular faces meeting at a soft rounded apex, a flat triangular base; soft rounded edges, a smooth stretch cover, it dents and bulges softly where the person leans on it. Silhouette and orientation exactly as #1/#2 (standing upright, apex up). STRICTLY NO chair shape, NO round bean bag, NO armrests, NO piping, NO zipper, NO visible brand tag, NO square cube.
EXACT SIZE: 66 cm tall (upright) x 75 x 75 cm base, 2.2 kg. ABSOLUTE SIZE RULE - VERY IMPORTANT: the Pyramid is a fixed-size object (66 cm tall upright, 75 x 75 cm base); it does NOT shrink for a child. For child KB (150 cm) sitting on the floor in front of it, the apex reaches about the top of her head / ears; the base is clearly wider than her shoulders.
COLOR: cherry red #790619 - see colour swatch #6: the exact same soft dusty cherry red (a muted light rose) over the whole cover, never shifting toward bright scarlet, pink, orange or brown. FABRIC: soft matte stretch cotton-spandex cover.

POSE LOCK (from #2 - pose, cushion orientation and camera only): the Pyramid stands UPRIGHT on the floor (apex pointing up) behind the child; the child sits on the floor in front of it leaning back comfortably against its sloped face, knees slightly bent, an open picture book resting on her thighs held with both hands, head tilted down a little toward the book with a gentle absorbed soft smile; seen from a front three-quarter angle at eye level.

PERSON - IDENTITY LOCK (Child KB (girl 10-12) - face reference #3 and expression sheet #4, panel 3 'bright smile' or panel 2 'soft smile'): European girl aged 10-12, about 150 cm tall, freckles across the nose and cheeks, slim pre-teen build, natural friendly smile (NOT an adult). HAIR: long straight auburn (red-brown) hair reaching below the shoulders, centre parting, NO bangs/fringe; no other hairstyle, not wavy, not braided. The face must be IDENTICAL to #3/#4 in every detail - same face shape, eyes, nose, mouth, skin, freckles, age and gender; do not beautify, age, or restyle. Expression: natural friendly smile (never neutral or blank).

OUTFIT (reference #5 - KID_B_01): ivory ringer T-shirt with grey collar and sleeve trims and a red 'LITTLE DEPT' chest print + heather-grey shorts with white piping trim. Cream ankle socks, no shoes. No accessories, no logos other than the print described.

SCENE / LIGHT: clean studio, seamless background and floor in very light grey #f2f2f4 (NOT pure white; no room, no coloured wall, no carpet, no furniture, no window, no plants), soft diffused daylight from the front-left, natural soft contact shadow under the cushion and the person, no props except the open book (no readable text), no text, no watermark, no logo.

CAMERA: 50 mm look, same near-frontal view and eye level as the pose reference, the whole cushion and the person fully in frame with comfortable margin, centered, square crop.
